subject: [PATCH 6.6.y] x86/tdx: Fix zero-extension for 32-bit port I/O

reviews.author: Sasha Levin
reviews.summary: The reviewer acknowledged the patch and queued it for the 6.6 kernel series without raising any technical concerns or suggestions.
reviews.raw_body:
> Use insn_assign_reg() to write the result back into RAX with proper
> partial-register-write semantics: 1- and 2-byte forms leave the upper
> bits untouched, the 4-byte form zero-extends to the full register.

Queued for 6.6, thanks.

-- 
Thanks,
Sasha

2026-09-03.patch_summary: The patch fixes a bug in the x86/tdx port I/O handling by properly zero-extending the result of 32-bit operations to 64 bits, as per x86 architecture rules.
